description: Many-to-many mapping between Tier-1 constitutional doctrines and landmark judgments
notes: Basic Structure is primarily anchored by Kesavananda and Minerva Mills.
S.R. Bommai applied Basic Structure to secularism and federalism.
Maneka Gandhi is the foundational expansion of Article 21 and is linked to reasonableness / due process rather than pure Basic Structure.
Ultra Vires, Severability and Eclipse are primarily statutory/constitutional construction doctrines and are less case-specific in the Tier-1 set.
